subject: Rename utility-worker to util-worker to adhere to 15 char name limit in linux (#1002)
reason: The change only renames the utility thread pool's name prefix from 'utility-worker-' to 'util-worker-' so that the string passed to pthread_setname_np fits Linux's 15-character thread-name limit. The name is used solely as an OS-level thread label for debugging (visible in /proc and top -H); it does not affect any command behavior, reply, indexing, replication, persistence, or memory path, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or observe it and none is needed.
